_comment: smart-trust's own site, as package scripts: the platform scripts fhir-harness's templates/ig-repo-site/folio-site.yml runs, with the arguments it passes, declared in order by index.config.json (the smart-trust entry) site.build and run by build-instance-site.ts (the one agent publish path, stage-local). The build's own values arrive in the environment (SITE_INSTANCE, SITE_TITLE, SITE_BASEURL, SITE_WORK, SITE_DIR, SITE_REPOSITORY, SITE_COMMIT, SITE_REF); a source or site step is given the site source or the built site as its last argument. site:ast refuses an AST cache that does not match this checkout, as the workflow rebuilds one; SITE_ACCEPT_STALE_AST=1 accepts it, for a preview only.
name: @litlfred/smart-trust-site

scripts.site:ast: bash fhir-harness/scripts/ig-cache.sh restore --ig-root . && { bun run fhir-harness/scripts/ig-ast.ts validity output-ast --ig . > "$SITE_WORK/ast-validity.json" || { cat "$SITE_WORK/ast-validity.json"; [ "$SITE_ACCEPT_STALE_AST" = 1 ] && echo 'site:ast: the AST cache does not match this checkout; accepted (SITE_ACCEPT_STALE_AST=1)'; }; }
scripts.site:index: bun run fhir-harness/scripts/ast-to-artifact-index.ts --ast output-ast --instance-id "$SITE_INSTANCE" --compare fhir-artifact-index/index.json --keep-published-grouping --sidecars fhir-artifact-index/sidecars --sidecars-local fhir-artifact-index/sidecars --out "$SITE_WORK/ast-index.json" --report "$SITE_WORK/ast-parity.json"
scripts.site:pages: bun run fhir-harness/scripts/gen-ig-pages.ts --instance . --publish-note "This page mirrors a published WHO Implementation Guide." --sidecar-label "DAK API" --label "WHO SMART Trust" --chrome-owner smart-base --index "$SITE_WORK/ast-index.json" --compiled-data ast-data --full-pages
scripts.site:ast-data: mkdir -p "$SITE_DIR/ast-data" && cp -a output-ast/resources "$SITE_DIR/ast-data/resources" && echo 'ast-data: the AST resources, served' #
scripts.site:stamp: GITHUB_REPOSITORY="$SITE_REPOSITORY" GITHUB_REF_NAME="$SITE_REF" GITHUB_SHA="$SITE_COMMIT" bun run fhir-harness/scripts/site-build-stamp.ts stamp --instance "$SITE_INSTANCE" --platform cat-harness-tools --site
